FAQ

Good questions.

What is a 3D commercial?
A 3D commercial is a film made entirely with computer-generated imagery. Your product, the world around it, the light and the camera are all built digitally, so there is no shoot, no set and no limit on what we can show. It lets brands tell stories that traditional video can't.
How much does it cost?
It depends on the scope, the length and the creative direction. The easiest way to get a number is to send us a brief. We'll have a quick chat about your product and come back with a clear quote.
How does the process work, and how much input do you need from me?
Send us a short brief and we'll set up a call to hear the story behind your product. From there we handle the concept, storyboard, modelling, animation and finishing, and you approve each stage. You can be as involved as you like. All we need from you is your product and the story behind it, and clear reference photos or CAD files make it faster.
How long does it take to get my final film?
It depends on the length of the film and the complexity of the world around your product. We agree a delivery date with you before any work begins, so you always know what to expect.
What are the advantages of 3D commercials?
They grab attention, explain a product clearly and show ideas that aren't possible with a camera. There are no studio hires, set builds or logistics, and everything we build can be reused for new campaigns, formats and platforms.
